residual_assessment.precise_problem: Can intervention on a bodily/action route orient an unoriented structural partition as familiar mineness without letting outcome value, marker coding or report define the target?
residual_assessment.net_increment_after_subtraction: A UCT-specific functional-versus-phenomenal direction boundary, exact 256-model interventional complement witness and an eight-field anchor adequacy contract; no claim of new causal-representation or latent-relabeling mathematics.

R173 actual retentive binding and B_fam boundary
residual_assessment.reusable_knowledge: Interventions can orient a latent coordinate only relative to independently ordered consequences. Transfer to a named experiential direction requires its own same-instance premise, measurement warrant and defeater.
residual_assessment.evidence_and_limits: Exact deterministic-binary enumeration, eight thought experiments, primary-source comparison and full v1.1.2 traversal. No actual instance, complete organization, valid phenomenal calibration or discharged B_dir.
residual_assessment.next_specific_action: Formalize one independently phenomenological direction-transfer candidate and preregister an outcome-reversal/stable-target defeater; abandon the candidate if its target direction is inherited only from task value or marker choice.
